Titel: Interim IFRS Consolidation Manager (fully remote)
Unternehmen: Tejo Shared Services, Lda.
Ort: Lissabon, Portugal (Remote)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187104829/
Abgerufen am: 22.09.2026 07:30

About the role
Tejo Shared Services runs the record-to-report hub for a European retail group with 60 legal entities. We are looking for an interim consolidation manager to cover the year-end close 2026 and the transition to SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting.

What you will do
- Own the monthly and year-end IFRS consolidation for the group
- Prepare intercompany reconciliations, eliminations and the consolidated cash flow statement
- Support the external auditor during the year-end audit
- Document consolidation processes and train the permanent team
- Work closely with the S/4HANA project team on data mapping and testing

What you bring
- 7+ years in IFRS consolidation, ideally in a shared service or group function
- Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting, SAP BPC or a comparable tool
- Fluent English; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus
- Available to start by mid-October 2026

Contract details
- Freelance contract, 6 months, full time
- Daily rate EUR 600 to 700, depending on experience
- 100% remote, working hours aligned to Lisbon time (WET)
- Due to our local contracting model you must be resident in Portugal or Spain and invoice through a local company. We cannot consider applicants based in other countries.
